title: Saturday 5K Pace Planner
description: Enter your 5K time, age and target to get an age-graded percentage, per-km splits for your course and a shareable result card. Works for any 5K, including weekly timed runs.

desktop.alt: The Saturday 5K Pace Planner on a desktop screen, near-black header with gold accents: a form asking for a PB, target time, age and age-grading category, filled with example times and a Plan my 5K button.

phone.alt: The Saturday 5K Pace Planner on a phone, showing example results: a 57.8% age grade for a 23:45 target and a table of five per-kilometre splits.

phoneForm.alt: The Saturday 5K Pace Planner on a phone showing the start of its form with example values: PB time, target time, age and category.

title: Court Night
description: Run a social padel night from your phone: americano or mexicano pairings court by court, real points scores and live standings. Free, no account, saved on your own device. Also works for tennis, badminton and pickleball.

desktop.alt: Court Night on a desktop screen, near-black header with gold accents: round 4 of an example night with two courts, score boxes for each pair, and a standings table beside it.

phone.alt: Court Night on a phone showing round 4 of an example night: two courts, each with two pairs of invented names and large score boxes, and who is sitting out.

phoneForm.alt: Court Night on a phone showing the setup form with ten invented player names added, a night name and a courts selector.
